messages.subject: RE: side by side barplot
parts:
I am trying to do side by side bar plot for each of the subpopulation
grouped by year .
In the following table . There are three columns in the following
table . Subgroup, geometricmean and year.
I want to bar plot side by side : Overall geometric mean in year 1 ,
Overall geometric mean in year 2
Similarly, 6-11 year geometric mean in year 1 , 6-11 year geometric
mean in year 2
.........
..........
Similarly, 60 year geometric mean in year 1 , 60 year geometric mean
in year 2

table:
Subgroup geometricmean year
Overall 6 1
6-11 4 1
12-19 3 1
20-59 5 1
60 7 1
Overall 8 2
6-11 5 2
12-19 4 2
20-59 3 2
60 2 2

R code:
here tt is the dataframe that contains the above table.
plot_base <- ggplot(tt,aes(Subgroup,geometricmean, group=year)) +
geom_bar()
> plot_base
But I did not get side by side barplot by year.
Can you please give me some suggestion so that I can modify the R code
to get the appropriate bar plot.
thanks
bayazid

messages.author: a5be32bcb3d808db
messages.subject: Re: side by side barplot
parts: The geom_bar stacks by default, so you need something like

geom_bar(stat="identity", position="dodge")

but this will not tell you which bar is which... Maybe you want

plot_base <- ggplot(tt,aes(Subgroup,geometricmean, fill=factor(year)))
+ geom_bar(stat="identity", position="dodge") + scale_fill_grey()

Best,
Ista
